landing.area.budget.title: Budget
landing.area.budget.text: Plan income and expenses following the 50/30/20 rule, bring Unassigned to 0, carry over last month and adjust only what changed.
landing.area.debts.title: Debts
landing.area.debts.text: Loans, mortgages, leases and private debts with amortization schedule, extra repayments and a debt-free date.
landing.area.cashflow.title: Cash flow
landing.area.cashflow.text: A day-by-day calendar with debit dates and running balance – spot bottlenecks before they happen.
landing.area.buffers.title: Buffers
landing.area.buffers.text: Reserves like an emergency fund or vacation with target, savings plan, withdrawal history and a forecast of when you reach the goal.
landing.area.overview.title: Overview
landing.area.overview.text: All key figures at a glance, with a traffic light per area and early warnings.
landing.area.statistics.title: Statistics
landing.area.statistics.text: Expenses by category, trends, savings rate, planned vs. actual, year comparison and net worth.
landing.area.forecasts.title: Forecasts
landing.area.forecasts.text: Project balance, debt freedom, savings goals and year end – including what-if scenarios.
landing.area.household.title: Plan together
landing.area.household.text: Invite your partner and family. Everyone sees the same data; changes appear instantly on all devices.
landing.area.pwa.title: Like an app
landing.area.pwa.text: Install it on your home screen, use it offline and get reminded at the start of the month – no app store.
landing.how.1.title: Enter your income
landing.how.1.text: Salary, child benefit and everything that comes in monthly. Then you know how much you can distribute.
landing.how.2.title: Give every euro a job
landing.how.2.text: Plan fixed costs, everyday life, wants, reserves and repayments until “Unassigned” reaches 0.
landing.how.3.title: Close the month & keep going
landing.how.3.text: Check items off, enter differences, close the month. Statistics and forecasts show your progress.
faq.1.a: Yes. All features can be used without a subscription and without a credit card.
faq.2.q: Do I have to connect my bank account?
faq.2.a: No, deliberately not. You enter amounts yourself. This builds awareness of your money, and your bank data stays with you.
faq.3.q: How is it different from an expense tracker?
faq.3.a: An expense tracker records afterwards where the money went. BudgetPlaner plans ahead: every euro gets a job before it is spent. You can still check items off and record actual amounts.
faq.4.a: Amounts and names are stored encrypted. You can export everything at any time (Excel, CSV, JSON) and delete your account completely.
faq.5.q: What do I need to get started?
faq.5.a: Just a rough idea of what comes in each month and what it is spent on. The setup assistant guides you through in under five minutes.
faq.6.a: For individuals, couples and families – from beginners to savings pros. Several people can plan a shared household.
faq.7.q: Can I use the app on my phone?
faq.7.a: Yes. BudgetPlaner is optimized for smartphones and can be installed without an app store (Android: “Install app”, iPhone: “Add to Home Screen”). Afterwards it also works offline.
faq.8.a: Yes. All features are available through a documented REST API. You create a personal API access token in your profile.
